question: Disha takes 12 hours to copy a 75-page manuscript, while Mohit can copy the same manuscript in 10 hours. How many hours will it take for them to copy a 150-page manuscript if they work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Disha takes 12 hours to copy a 75-page manuscript.

Mohit can copy 75-page manuscript in 10 hours

**Concept used:**

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time.

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of Disha is 75 /12 = 25/4&
